title: Use one phase-aware named-root assessment with explicit read horizons
outcome: Use one phase-aware named-root assessment with explicit read horizons
acceptance: A source A-to-B-to-A report and a foreign known root sighting keep existing movement outcomes; no redundant declared_not_contradicted branch is removed without a regression proving the earlier movement owner covers the same transition
Admission and consumption use one source assessment owner whose explicit phase retains initial-sighting-through-cut admission and declared-source confirmation-through-head consumption

Tests cover initial old sighting then a new uncontradicted declaration (records but blocks done until confirmed), contradicted declaration (refused/void), never-sighted declaration (blocks newest record until replaced), and undeclared judgment using its evaluated cut

completion.summary: A named root's binding and source are assessed by one owner each (assess_named_root_binding, assess_named_root_source) with an explicit RootPhase: admission reads the declared workspace, then the binding at head lazily, then the sighting through the cut with the open-declaration check kept; consumption reads the stored binding and confirms a declared revision through the head and an undeclared one at its cut. Reasons, causes and guard order unchanged. A 212-cell characterization table measured on the pre-move code passes unchanged, with a row-uniqueness check and a removal-evidence probe for the kept declaration check. Landed b4c0896 after two rounds (round 1 void: Codex blocked by TermAl w-27f08e988f1e; Claude's Notes fixed), full gate test-d23eb69d 9/9, independent evaluation passed 3/3.
